captureMethod.application: Running Expo web preview through the available browser surface
captureMethod.limitation: The available browser surface exposes no viewport control and rejects DOM mutation; its host remained 1280×720, so an exact 393×852 overlay and pixel-difference image cannot honestly be generated from this capture.

remainingDifferences: The application does not use the 393×852 Figma fixture's three vendor groups and three product lines; the live cart correctly renders the persisted cart state instead.
